source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1939, p. 3 ("Local elections: the Mayor of Ballymena defeated (Antrim County Council)"); Belfast News-Letter, 4 May 1939, p. 13 ("Local elections: Antrim Co. Council nominations; contest in Ballymena?"); Irish News, 4 May 1939, p. 2 ("Co. Antrim Council nominations received"); Irish News, 2 June 1939, p. 9 ("Antrim County Council: poll in Ballymena"); Ballymena Observer, 2 June 1939, p. 5 ("Polling in the Ballymena division for County Council election takes place to-day (Thursday)")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: county council contest, not a borough poll: the Antrim County Council nominations list (BNL 4 May 1939 p. 13) names Shaw and Gillespie for the Ballymena division, and the result was counted at the County Courthouse, Crumlin Road, and printed under 'Antrim County Council' (BNL 3 June 1939 p. 3): Gillespie 2,166; Shaw 1,274; majority 892; 25 spoiled papers

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations closed at the County Courthouse, Crumlin Road, on 3 May 1939, withdrawals to 10 May, and polling day was Thursday 1 June 1939 ('Polling day is June 1', Belfast News-Letter, 4 May 1939, p. 13; 'Polling in the Ballymena division for County Council election takes place to-day (Thursday)', Ballymena Observer, 2 June 1939, p. 5; 'Polling took place yesterday', Irish News, 2 June 1939, p. 9). The only contest was in the Ballymena (borough) division, counted at the Courthouse, Crumlin Road, on 2 June (Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1939, p. 3). The Belfast News-Letter of 1 June 1939 says the Ballymena poll took place 'yesterday'; that is contradicted by the three sources above and is taken as an error. No party labels were printed. Poll date 1 June 1939: filed under 1939-06-01 (renamed from 1939-05-31, gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Shaw, the first Mayor of Ballymena, had represented the division since 1930; he was defeated by Gillespie.
